name: cx-goal-many-rules
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task says to open the door with the key, but no clause orders has_door_key before door_open. Add hard Precedence(has_door_key, door_open); the environment’s key requirement does not replace the task’s stated order.

texts: Move the ball away before taking the key.
Prefer not to lose the key while the door is closed.
Whenever holding the key, preferably have the door open then or open it afterwards.
Have the key before opening the door with it.
Open the door before picking up the box.
